description: Recording time axis, shared by every trial. Sample interval = 0.05 ms.
Observed (noisy) membrane potential for each trial. Row order matches condition_id/trial arrays.
Stimulus condition index for each row of V_obs_mV. Join with stimulus_protocol.csv.
Detected spike time within the trial, from an independent spike detector. Not derived from V_obs_mV directly -- do not expect exact sample alignment.
Commanded (DC) injected current for this condition. The true injected current fluctuates around this value -- see handout Section 2 for the noise model.
Number of repeated trials recorded at this condition.
'fit' = intended for parameter estimation. 'holdout' = reserved for validation; do not use these conditions when fitting model parameters.
